items.title: 12.1 Reactivity of nitrogen (N2) (nitrogen kitna react karti hai) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.1 with Figure 12.1, printed page 274.

blocks.text: Nitrogen hawa ka bara hissa hai. Yeh bohat kam react karti hai, kyun ke (1) is ka size chhota hai, (2) is ka electron cloud symmetrical (har taraf barabar) hai, aur (3) is ka triple bond non-polar hai. Nitrogen ki electronic configuration 1s² 2s² 2p³ hai, yani octet poora karne ke liye ise teen electrons chahiye. Is liye do nitrogen atoms teen teen electrons share kar ke triple bond banate hain (Figure 12.1). Is bond ki bond enthalpy +944 kJmol⁻¹ hai. Naye bond banane se pehle yeh bond torna parta hai, aur is ke liye bohat energy chahiye; is liye N₂ bohat unreactive hai. Doosri wajah bond ka non-polar hona hai: dono atoms ek jaise hain, electronegativity ka farq zero (sifar) hai, is liye teenon bonded pairs dono atoms mein barabar share hote hain.

blocks.alt: Do bare circle (daira) ek doosre par chadhe hue, har ek ke andar N ke gird chhota circle. Left chhote circle par neele dots (nuqton) ka pair aur right par red pair. Bilkul left edge (kinare) par neela pair aur right edge par red pair. Jahan dono bare circle milte hain wahan chhe dots, bari bari neele aur red, ek line mein. Right side N≡N likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.1: N2 molecule mein bonding (kitab ki Figure 12.1 jaisa original diagram).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neele dots left N ke electrons hain aur red dots right N ke. Dono circle jahan milte hain wahan teen pairs (chhe electrons) share kiye (baante) gaye hain: yahi teen bonds, yani N≡N triple bond hai. Har N ke bahar wale edge par ek lone pair (akela jora) hai, aur chhote circle par inner shell (andar wala khol) ke do electrons. Is tarah har N ke outer shell (bahar wala khol) mein aath electrons poore ho jate hain.

blocks.caption: N₂ inert kyun hai
rows: naye bond banne se pehle +944 kJmol⁻¹ energy deni parti hai
dono atoms ek jaise, electronegativity ka farq zero, electrons barabar share
attack (hamla) karne wale reagent ke liye koi kamzor jagah nahi

blocks.title: Interesting Information (dilchasp maloomat)
blocks.text: Hawa mein nitrogen ki zyada amount (miqdar) oxygen ko halka (dilute) kar deti hai; is liye atmosphere (fiza) mein har spark (chingari) bari aag nahi bhadkati. Jahazon par hydrocarbons ya khaane ke tel (edible oils) ki bari shipment (khep) ko oxygen aur moisture (nami) se bachane ke liye un par nitrogen ya kisi aur inert gas ka 'kambal' (blanket) dala jata hai. Laboratory mein bhi woh reactions jin ko inert environment (mahol) chahiye, nitrogen mein kiye jate hain.

blocks.prompt: N₂ ki kam reactivity (inertness) ki do reasons (wajuhat) batayein (exercise Q.2a).
blocks.explanation: (1) N≡N triple bond bohat mazboot hai (+944 kJmol⁻¹); naye bond banne se pehle ise torna parta hai. (2) Bond non-polar hai: dono atoms ek jaise hain, is liye molecule par koi positive ya negative end (sira) nahi jahan reagent attack kar sake.

items: N₂ inert hai: mazboot triple bond (+944 kJmol⁻¹), non-polar bond, chhota size aur symmetrical electron cloud.
Nitrogen hawa mein oxygen ko dilute karti hai aur jahazon aur laboratory mein inert 'blanket' ka kaam deti hai.
